Support is limited to the defined direct-customer residual.

reviews.rationale: The packet lacks comparable realized spending that separates ultimate demand outside OpenAI and Anthropic. Customer concentration, product growth and future commitments cannot establish whether the remaining market was a minor residual. The qualitative claim is assessable under the fair contextual reading, but these measurements do not settle it.

contract.note: The broad startup reading fits the surrounding discussion. Requiring broad financing consequences and preserving the unspecified response horizon fairly operationalizes the prediction.

Strong aggregate AI investment weighs against narrative collapse, but year-to-date concentration does not isolate post-closure fundraising conditions, acquisitions or causation.

reviews.rationale: Yupp's closure satisfies the broad antecedent, but the packet neither establishes nor decisively refutes the predicted broad financing consequences. The universal self-sufficiency premise also lacks company-level evidence. No response deadline was supplied, and the early-resolution rule is not met.

contract.note: Requiring actual non-payment on AI data-center loans fairly captures the financial prediction. An indefinite horizon cannot expire merely because no default has yet been found.

evidence.note: The tracker finds no public neocloud GPU-loan default. Its narrower coverage and absence of a deadline prevent this from contradicting the forecast.
